single_next_action: PHASE 61 — LARGE-SCALE FOUNDATION PRETRAINING DATA PIPELINE
rationale: E5 architecture scaling (3.16M parameters) proved that increasing capacity without scaling token volume (requires 50M+ tokens for 3.16M parameters, vs current 855k tokens) leads to undertraining. The scientifically required next phase is building the 50M+ token pretraining corpus.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT add more layers or parameters (E6) until pretraining dataset is built.
Do NOT enable Public Chat candidate traffic until pretraining and instruction tuning pass >35% CAP probes.
Do NOT delete versioned phase snapshot files during active governance phase.
